# Biology Insights

> > Biology Insights explores animal biology, biotechnology, and regenerative science through comprehensive guides and research-driven articles.

Biology Insights covers diverse topics spanning animal physiology, behavioral biology, neuroscience, and sustainable biotechnology applications. The site combines educational documentation with accessible blog content on topics from insect communication to algae cultivation and disease modeling research.

## Key Topics

- animal-biology
- anatomy-physiology
- disease-models
- regeneration
- behavior
- biotechnology
- algae-cultivation
- microalgae-farming

- Beetles
- Brain Tissue

## Neuroscience & Regeneration

- [Normal Brain Tissue: Structure, Cells, and Function](https://biologyinsights.com/normal-brain-tissue-structure-cells-and-function): Educational guide on brain tissue structure, neurons, glial cells, and neurobiology fundamentals.
- [Zebrafish Eye: Regeneration and Human Disease Models](https://biologyinsights.com/zebrafish-eye-regeneration-and-human-disease-models): Guide to zebrafish eye regeneration research, retinal repair, and human vision disorder models.

## Sustainable Biotechnology

- [What Is Algae Cultivation and How Does It Work?](https://biologyinsights.com/what-is-algae-cultivation-and-how-does-it-work): Guide to algae cultivation principles using microalgae, photobioreactors, and sustainable farming methods.

## Animal Biology & Physiology

- [Do Oysters Have Blood and a Circulatory System?](https://biologyinsights.com/do-oysters-have-blood-and-a-circulatory-system): Article on oyster hemolymph, hemocyanin, and open circulatory system biology.
- [The Rabbit Human Relationship: Pets, Health, and Culture](https://biologyinsights.com/the-rabbit-human-relationship-pets-health-and-culture): Article on rabbit breeds, pet care, zoonotic diseases, and human-animal bonds.

## Animal Behavior & Communication

- [Beetle Sounds: How They're Made and What They Mean](https://biologyinsights.com/beetle-sounds-how-theyre-made-and-what-they-mean): Article on beetle acoustics, stridulation, and communication in Deathwatch and bark beetles.
- [What Causes Locust Migration and Swarms?](https://biologyinsights.com/what-causes-locust-migration-and-swarms): Article exploring locust swarm behavior, phenotypic plasticity, and environmental triggers.
- [Why Do Birds Chirp Before a Storm?](https://biologyinsights.com/why-do-birds-chirp-before-a-storm): Article on bird pre-storm behavior, atmospheric sensing, and avian communication science.

## Core Resources

- [Biology Insights](https://biologyinsights.com): Homepage introducing Biology Insights' coverage of animal biology and biotechnology topics.
